messages:
Rina CSM: Quick — building a 1-paragraph "lightning checklist" AEs can paste into kickoff notes. Must cover prefill, batching guidance, streaming fallback, health checks, and renewal signals. Keep it tiny and copy-paste ready.
Omar SE: Love it. Two lanes: customer-facing sentence + ops bullets. Give exact knobs so SEs can act.
Lina DevEx: I'll add two snippets: small prefill curl and a one-line PromQL smoke.
Rina CSM: Customer paste (single line): "Well prefill your top intents to cut cold tails; expect a ~10min warm window and p95 within targeted SLOs during ramp."
Omar SE: Ops bullets (copy):
- prefill_ttl: 900s default, up to 1800s for long context
- warm_pool: enable for steady traffic (>200rps), burst_pool_ttl: 300s
- batch_target_tokens: 512 (low-latency) | 1024 (balanced) | 2048 (throughput)
- streaming: enabled; fallback to short-model non-stream when stream errors spike
Lina DevEx: Prefill curl (copy):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \\  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\  -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","intents":["faq_search","summary"],"ttl":900}'
```
Lina DevEx: PromQL smoke (copy):
```promql
100 * sum(rate(redwood_cache_hit_total[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_request_total[5m]))
```
Omar SE: Client pattern: add 0-200ms jitter + 2 fast retries. If stream_error_rate > 12% for 10m, auto-fallback to non-stream and open SE ticket.
Rina CSM: Renewal signals (copy):
- sustained p95 > 1.2s for 12h
- cache hit < 35% for 48h
- stream error rate > 12% for 48h
- week-over-week cost jump > 25%
Rina CSM: Short AE email (paste): "We saw degraded latency on key flows. We're enabling extra warm capacity and will monitor closely; expect a follow-up with metrics within 24h."
BeaconBot: Confluence page created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/onboarding/lightning-checklist-snippets
Rina CSM: Thanks team 64f3fb. I'll add to the kickoff template and ship.
